result.detail: Traceability: requirement [requirement:req-294155bac1] -> interface spec [artifact:prj-5c0d85843a.interface-spec.a1] (reviewed per [evidence:prj-5c0d85843a.interface-spec.e1]) -> microarchitecture [artifact:prj-5c0d85843a.microarchitecture.a1] (reviewed per [evidence:prj-5c0d85843a.microarchitecture.e1]) -> apb_regs.v / apb_regs_tb.v. Spec rules applied: APB4 setup then access phases, pready always high, pslverr defined only in the access phase, and the PSLVERR policy for unmapped addresses (interface spec sections 4-5). The tb uses its own address decode and strobe mask, written independently of the DUT. Open items for the reviewer to decide on: whether to require a SymbiYosys formal_spec plus formal.cover in a follow-up, and the failing-path testbench, both listed in the microarchitecture verification plan but not delivered here. Only the default parameters (ADDR_WIDTH=8, DATA_WIDTH=32) are supported, as the spec allows. This work still needs independent review; it is not self-approved.
